WITH first_loan_client AS (
    SELECT l.account_id
    FROM loan l
    WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05'
    ORDER BY l.loan_id
    LIMIT 1
),
balance_start AS (
    SELECT t.account_id, t.balance AS start_balance
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.date = '1993-03-22'
      AND t.account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM first_loan_client)
    ORDER BY t.trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
balance_end AS (
    SELECT t.account_id, t.balance AS end_balance
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.date = '1998-12-27'
      AND t.account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM first_loan_client)
    ORDER BY t.trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    (e.end_balance - s.start_balance) * 1.0 / s.start_balance AS increase_rate
FROM balance_start s
JOIN balance_end e ON s.account_id = e.account_id;
